units: Hourly UTC; temperature degrees C; relative humidity percent; wind metres per second; radiation W per square metre; precipitation millimetres
source_semantics: gfs_seamless is a stitched historical forecast archive; this is a retrospective replay, not a single issued forecast and not an operational forecast
required_variable_policy: Standard SNOWPACK forcing fields are mapped explicitly to source or derived adapter fields
direct_snowfall_policy: Unavailable/null in this source snapshot; preserve null and never substitute zero
snow_depth_policy: Source QA only; do not assimilate as SNOWPACK HS
missingness_policy: Core input gaps fail closed before native execution; material repair is not silently delegated to defaults
meteoio_policy: Explicit upstream input QA with PSUM resampling accumulated over 3600 seconds
